description: Recommend tools for a task in the context of one saved project, so the user does not repeat the project background every turn. Reads the project's accepted/rejected tool lists, stage and known context; a tool this project rejected is never re-pushed; a tool already in use is judged keep / supplement / replace, each with an evidence_level (user_stated / client_observed / assistant_inferred). May answer need_clarification with exactly one question, or no_match when no catalog tool verifies the task — never pads with unverified candidates. Requires project_id and an Authorization: Bearer credential (owner key or project token); a key passed as a tool argument is never accepted.
name: recommend_for_task
title: Recommend for this project
